disputed_verses.KJV 1CH 15:7: Of the sons of Gershom; Joel the chief and his brethren an hundred and thirty:

first_reader_said: 1CH 15:7: Both records are Joel chief of the sons of Gershom at the bringing up of the ark.

why: Both records identify the same Joel, chief of the Gershonites, in 1CH 15:7; 1CH 15:11 names him again among David's summoned Levites. B's additional references place Joel alongside Zetham in Laadan's family (1CH 23:8) and identify him as Zetham's brother in the treasury service (1CH 26:22). A contains no distinguishing lineage or chronological information and is a thinner copy of B.
